CASE INCIDENT InnoHealth Tech: Transforming Remote Healthcare InnoHealth Tech, a forward-thinking tech company, is on a mission to revolutionize remote healthcare. They've recently developed a cutting-edge wearable device capable of real-time vital sign monitoring. Jaya, their lead Design Thinking professional, is spearheading the project. Her goal is to fine-tune the device's user experience and make it a game-changer in the healthcare industry. Jaya applied the 4 phase process of E.A.S.T Jaya's first step was conducting extensive research on healthcare professionals and patients. During this she uncovered a complex challenge: while the device provided valuable data, it overwhelmed both patients and professionals alike. Jaya then collaborated with the tech team, brainstorming solutions that ranged from streamlined interfaces to advanced data analytics. After rigorous prototyping, the team zeroed in on a mobile app. This app would present users with a simplified dashboard, offering personalized health recommendations based on the data. The challenge now was the app's promotion. They had a budget constraint but needed to make a significant impact in the healthcare market.

questions.correct_answer: Balancing data granularity with simplicity
